canonical_data: service-managed sessions, search history, saved memories, projects, instructions, uploaded and connected files, and generated artifacts
current_repo_note: This record covers the core Perplexity web, desktop, and mobile assistant, including the Android Assistant surface. Perplexity Computer, Comet, and the Perplexity API remain distinct operational products.
strengths: Search-grounded conversational answers and iterative Research combine visible citations with strong source transparency
Sessions, editable memory, and persistent Projects support continuity across questions, files, instructions, and ongoing work
First-class model choice, file and application connectors, exports, asset creation, and mobile assistance provide a broad end-user surface
weaknesses: The operational implementation, retrieval stack, and stored context are proprietary and service-managed
Models, usage limits, memory behavior, connectors, and creation features vary by plan, platform, administrator settings, and rollout stage
Consumer data controls and portability are less comprehensive than the enterprise governance boundary and remain dependent on Perplexity's service
why_it_matters: A category-defining answer engine that has grown into a broad, source-aware assistant with durable context, multi-model choice, research, creation, and device-level assistance.
